name_input: SARASWATI WOOD PRIVATE LIMITED; SARASWATI WOOD PVT LTD; SARASWATI WOOD PRIVATE LIMITED
export_evidence: ImportKey page for slug 'saraswati-wood-private-limited' (https://importkey.com/countries/india/saraswati-wood-private-limited) reports 'Total Shipments 979 Records detected' and 'Latest Cargo 2026-02-28', but every visible row is an INBOUND shipment into India, e.g. '2026-02-28 | SCA WOOD HONG KONG LTD. | SARASWATI WOOD PRIVATE LIMITED | SPRUCE SAWN TIMBER (PICEA ABIES) | Gvle, SWEDEN | MUNDRA SEA INMUN1, India | 44071200 | BOL 7799577'. Top ports listed are all Indian discharge ports (MUNDRA SEA 103, MUNDRA SEA INMUN1 36, DELHI AIR 18). No outbound/export row with an Indian port of loading and a foreign destination was seen. Source counter: page claims 979 total shipments; rows actually seen = 5 shipment rows, 5 supplier rows, 2 buyer rows, 5 port rows — all import-side. Slug variants 'saraswati-wood-pvt-ltd' and 'saraswati-wood' returned zero populated records ('Loading...' / empty tables).
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender, contract award or annual-report split could be retrieved. web_search (DuckDuckGo/searx) returned 'Connection refused' on every attempt, and volza.com and eximpedia.app returned HTTP 403 Forbidden, so no domestic-supply record was read. Field left as unknown rather than inferred.
note: IMPORTANT DIRECTION CORRECTION: the declared HS 440712 (coniferous wood sawn/chipped, >6mm) matches the goods in the customs records, but the company appears in Indian customs data as an IMPORTER of softwood/hardwood timber, not as an exporter. Evidence line: 'SPRUCE SAWN TIMBER (PICEA ABIES)- Gvle, SWEDEN MUNDRA SEA INMUN1, India 44071200 7799577' — origin Sweden, destination India. Other observed inbound lanes: Kotka, Finland (44071100, BOL 7742227); Saint Petersburg/Belarus (44071100, BOL 7696936); Rio Grande, Brazil (44039800, BOL 7679995). So there are real, dated customs movements, but they are purchases into India; no export shipment with date, destination and B/L was found, hence export_status = none_found (not 'declared_only', since the company does not even claim exports in the sources read). Address on record is 74/20-21, Amar Colony Main, Rohtak Road, Nangloi — i.e. Delhi, which conflicts with the claimed state Gujarat; this is a registry/identity question outside my scope and is flagged, not resolved. PAN AAPCS6579L and revenue/export volume: not verifiable from the sources accessible here — left null, not estimated. Per project rule 5, no 'conditionally accepted' softening: no trace of outbound supply found in the one accessible shipment source; domestic supply evidence could not be checked at all because search and the two secondary aggregators were unreachable/blocked.
